title: RP Best Guns for VPB
description: This is a weapon pack for the Vic's Point Blank mod, the pack contains many, many different weapons for every taste!
body:
The pack contains different weapons: T-34, KV-2, BT-5, Bulbashooter, Super Duper Powerful Double-Barreled Shotgun, Double-Barreled Shotgun, machine guns, etc.

ATTENTION! for this pack to work you need to download the Vic's Point Blank mod! and create a folder in your version with the name a pointblank range and insert the pack there Nice game!
